# Vendored frontend assets

- `basecoat-maia.min.css` is the Basecoat CSS 1.1.0 Maia CDN bundle, vendored for self-hosted use without a runtime CDN dependency.
- Basecoat license: `BASECOAT-LICENSE.md` (MIT).
- The bundle includes Tailwind CSS-generated styles; see `TAILWIND-LICENSE.md` (MIT).
- Update from `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/basecoat-css@1.1.0/dist/basecoat-maia.cdn.min.css` when intentionally upgrading Basecoat.
